high_level_description: The image is the cover of the book "The Metamorphosis" by Franz Kafka. The design is striking and surreal, featuring a central illustration that blends human and insect elements. Text: At the top of the cover, the title "THE METAMORPHOSIS" is written in bold, uppercase letters. Below the title, the author's name, "FRANZ KAFKA," is also displayed in uppercase letters. Illustration: The central figure is a man with a human face, but his body is transformed into that of a large insect
